abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate ultrasonic and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and Doppler examination in fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT), in respect to the postnatal findings and histological type of the tumor. STUDY DESIGN: Nine pregnancies complicated by histologically mature fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma in four cases and by immature/malignant teratoma in five cases. Transabdominal ultrasonic imaging and Doppler velocity waveforms were recorded during the second or last trimester in all cases, first trimester ultrasound examination was carried out in six cases and last trimester MRI in five cases. These findings were compared with postnatal and operative findings of the children. RESULTS: Ultrasound examination did not reveal intrapelvic parts of SCT, but this was possible by MRI. Velocity waveforms of the tumor arteries were similar in all histological types and the resistance index varied from 60 to 70. The mean gestational age at antepartal diagnosis was 25.2 weeks. Large tumor size with relatively large proportion of solid components was often recognized in cases with malignant/immature histology. CONCLUSIONS: Antepartal MRI is useful for examination of fetal SCT, but reliable differentiation of mature and immature SCT is not possible antepartally.
abstract_ja:
目的：胎児仙尾部奇形腫(SCT)について、超音波検査、MRI、ドプラ検査を出生後の所見および腫瘍の組織型と比較し評価すること。
研究デザイン：組織学的に成熟型の胎児SCTが4例、未熟型/悪性奇形腫が5例であった9妊娠。妊娠中期または後期に全例で経腹超音波検査とドプラ血流波形を記録し、妊娠初期の超音波検査を6例、妊娠後期のMRIを5例で施行した。これらの所見を児の出生後および手術所見と比較した。
結果：超音波検査では骨盤内の成分は描出されず、MRIで描出可能であった。腫瘍動脈の血流波形は全組織型で類似し、抵抗指数は60〜70であった。出生前診断時の平均妊娠週数は25.2週であった。未熟型/悪性型の症例では、腫瘍サイズが大きく充実成分の割合が比較的多いことがしばしば認められた。
結論：出生前MRIは胎児SCTの評価に有用であるが、出生前に成熟型と未熟型を確実に鑑別することはできない。
